svg.text: RpiHA: where to solder on the Guitar Hero Arcade fret board
Raw Thrills PCB1259C, ASSY #500-00022-04 (revision 4), component side. Parts are simplified; positions and sizes are to scale, measured from 300 dpi scans.
C One fret circuit, enlarged (ORANGE shown)
All five frets use the same circuit. The wire goes to the pad of C1x
that faces R2x (the white dot on the marked photo).
D Accelerometer resistors: rev 4 vs rev 3
upper pads of R8, R9, R10
lower pads of R8, R9, R10
small cap left of tantalum, upper pad
1. Desolder U1 (MC9S08JM60). The Pico takes over its USB lines and inputs.
2. Never plug in the Pico's micro-USB and the guitar cable at the same time.
3. Rev 3 boards: points 7, 8 and 9 go to the lower pads of R8, R9 and R10.
4. Compare with SKAN PCB/MCU.png, SKAN PCB/FRET.png and the original scans.
test pads on the underside, next to the USB socket
